title: Why is walking humans’ superpower? – C1 English Listening Test

seo.title: Why is walking humans' superpower? – C1 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Discover why walking is humans’ superpower in this C1 English Listening Test. Watch the video, answer the questions, and check your feedback!

parts:
C1 English Listening Test

Listen to an interview with a neuroscientist talking about how walking shaped human evolution and why it’s still vital today. For questions 1–7, choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
See the full list of C1 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: According to Dr Hammond, what did bipedal walking change?

choices.html: How humans moved, thought, and socialised.
How humans moved, thought and planned.

questions.prompt: Which theory says safety influenced the transition to bipedalism?
There's unlikely to be one single true theory.
Which theory helps explain how human intelligence developed?
Which of the following can be inferred from what Dr Hammond says?

choices.html: Our genes are adapting to walk less.
Walking might be beneficial for people with depression.
Creative people tend to walk more.

questions.prompt: A piece of research showed that people walking can have 100% more ideas than people sitting.
What would bring the greatest positive effects according to Dr Hammond?

choices.html: A stroll in a park with ponds.
A quick-paced walk along a stream in the forest.
